Here is the plain-English breakdown:

* **We are using AI to change how we work:** We are excited to use AI so teams work together better and deliver value to our stakeholders faster.
* **We are following a clear plan:** Teams can brainstorm toward a shared main goal, share what they learn with each other, and produce results that can grow.
* **It helps us adapt and move fast:** This will help everyone handle fast-changing situations with clear purpose, work more quickly, and keep coming up with new ideas.
